content: ML Kit face detection: faces must be at least 100x100 px in input (200x200 for contours); full-gallery bitmaps are slow and memory heavy - downsample via inSampleSize to about 1024-1280 longest edge and lower minFaceSize (default 0.1) for small faces. Old face-detection 16.1.7 native lib incompatible with 16 KB pages (googlesamples/mlkit issue 1024) - bundle a current version.
